## a bit about me

- i'm RedStar, Red to my friends, and i'm 21
- i'm based in Italy
- i'm hooked on programming (mostly Vue, TypeScript, JavaScript and CSS) and on tech in general
- i look after WolfStar, a Discord moderation bot, and its dashboard

## what i've made

- [**WolfStar**](https://wolfstar.rocks): A multipurpose Discord bot built around moderation, with a web dashboard to manage every server setting. Fork of Skyra _(maintainer)_
- [**Stars Components**](https://stars-components.js.org): HTTP-first TypeScript framework and toolkit for building Discord applications, plus a set of plugins on top _(maintainer)_
- [**newt-ui**](https://newtui.dev): Discord-styled component library for React, Vue and plain HTML/CSS, built on one shared design token system _(maintainer)_
- [**unplugin-version-injector**](https://github.com/RedStar071/unplugin-version-injector): Injects your package version or build date into built files. Works with Vite, Rollup, Rolldown, esbuild, Webpack, Rspack and Farm _(author)_
- [**wolfstar.rocks**](https://wolfstar.rocks): The website and dashboard for WolfStar, built with Nuxt _(maintainer)_
- [**Staryl**](https://github.com/wolfstar-project/staryl): The original Star Network bot, for notifications and socials _(maintainer)_
